blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Police arrested a 55-year-old man and seized 5.28 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) with an estimated street value of P35,904 during an anti-illegal drug operation in Linapacan, Palawan, on Saturday, Sept. 26. The Police Regional Office Mimaropa said the operation was conducted at about 10 a.m. in Purok 5, Barangay San Miguel, by personnel of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU), Linapacan Municipal Police Station, Palawan Provincial Police Office’s Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit and Provincial Intelligence Unit. The operation was coordinated with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office Mimaropa. READ: 2 nabbed, […]...
